name: Pirate Night Late-Night Deck/Cabanas Buffet: Smoked Turkey Legs, Crepes & Taco Bar
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Pirate in the Caribbean Late-Night Buffet
whyItWorks: On select sailings offering the late-night Pirate Buffet after fireworks, the freshly folded chocolate/vanilla crepes and carved turkey are gentle late-night bites.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to a warm crepe with chocolate/vanilla sauce or plain carved turkey meat; avoid heavy fried churros/empanadas and spicy jalapeño nachos right before bed.
watchOuts: Late-night large fatty meals can trigger nocturnal reflux/cramping
